branches.summary: Newton's Principia (1687) set F = ma and universal gravitation, and Euler, Lagrange and Hamilton recast mechanics analytically.
branches.title: Newtonian mechanics

branches.summary: Coulomb, Young, Faraday and Maxwell unified electricity, magnetism and light in Maxwell's equations (1865), notably ∇×B = μ₀J + μ₀ε₀∂E/∂t.
branches.title: Electromagnetism and optics

branches.summary: Carnot, Joule, Clausius and Boltzmann established the laws of thermodynamics and the statistical entropy S = k log W.
branches.title: Thermodynamics and statistical mechanics

branches.summary: The Planck-Einstein relation E = hν underpins spectroscopy, lasers and atomic clocks, making atoms and light precision probes.
branches.title: Atomic, molecular, optical physics

branches.summary: Einstein's 1905 special relativity and 1915 field equations Rμν − ½R gμν = 8πG Tμν/c⁴ replaced absolute space and time with spacetime curvature.
branches.title: Relativity and gravitation

branches.summary: Planck's E = hν, Schrödinger's iħ∂ψ/∂t = Ĥψ and Dirac's equation grew into quantum field theory and gauge theory.
branches.title: Quantum mechanics and QFT

branches.summary: Radioactivity, the nucleus and cosmic rays led to quarks, electroweak unification, QCD and the Higgs boson.
branches.title: Nuclear and particle physics

branches.summary: Electrons in solids, superconductivity and many-body theory produced semiconductors, quantum Hall states and topological materials.
branches.title: Condensed matter physics

branches.summary: General relativity, Hubble's law and the cosmic microwave background established an expanding universe with dark matter and dark energy.
branches.title: Astrophysics and cosmology

branches.summary: Poincaré's three-body problem, chaos, solitons, biophysics and network science revealed emergent nonlinear and collective behavior.
branches.title: Nonlinear dynamics and complexity

branches.summary: Quantum gravity, dark-sector searches, fusion, quantum computing and AI-driven discovery are leading unsolved problems as of 2026.
branches.title: Open frontier 2026
